leads.claim: The U.S. government has conducted a multi-decade UAP crash retrieval and reverse engineering program.
leads.why: The claimant asserts direct knowledge of a specific, long-term government program involving the retrieval and reverse engineering of UAP material.
leads.government_response: The witness claims he was denied access to these programs when he requested it.
leads.quote: I was informed in the course of my official duties of a multi-decade UAP crash retrieval and reverse engineering program

leads.claim: The U.S. is in possession of nonhuman spacecraft and artifacts that have circulated among defense contractors.
leads.why: The claim explicitly identifies the possession of physical nonhuman spacecraft and links them to defense contractors.
leads.quote: the U.S. is in possession of, quote, ‘‘nonhuman spacecraft,’’ end quote, and that some of these artifacts have circulated with defense contractors.

leads.claim: Nonhuman biologics were recovered alongside UAP craft.
leads.why: The claimant asserts that biological material was recovered during UAP retrieval operations based on interviews with individuals currently on the program.
leads.quote: biologics came with some of these recoveries. Yes. ... Nonhuman, and that was the assessment of people with direct knowledge

doc_verdict: The document contains sworn testimony from a former intelligence official asserting the existence of U.S. government programs for the retrieval and reverse engineering of nonhuman spacecraft and the recovery of nonhuman biological material.
